doc: The texel-center convention: sampling an 8x16 float32 image at the grid_dirs of its own size returns the image itself (column i is at longitude -pi + (i + 0.5) 2pi/W, row j at pi/2 - (j + 0.5) pi/H, so fx = i, fy = j exactly up to 1e-13). The output is float64 even for a float32 image. rtol 1e-9, atol 1e-12.
